text: athena land --pr judges the checks of the job's own commit, not the pull request's current head. When a fix is pushed to the pull request (on 2026-10-18, PR #149 for job 20261018-145008-k7fq), land keeps re-running and reporting the old commit's failure even though the new head is green, so the only way to merge was around land. Make land judge the checks of the pull request's current head, and refuse to merge when that head contains changes beyond the verified content and records unless each extra commit is a declared intervention.
